lanes.name: Audio — cloud nodes, utilities, and the two measured Motif workflows

extras.name: Core AudioSeparation = Demucs htdemucs 4-stem (MEASURED)
extras.note: MEASURED 2026-08-19: the Comfy-core AudioSeparation node outputs exactly Bass/Drums/Other/Vocals and decodes at 44.1 kHz REGARDLESS of input rate (Demucs native) — a 48 kHz ACE-Step mix yields 44.1 kHz stems in the same graph (5,292,000 samples = 120.000 s, header-decoded). MIT code+weights: THE commercial-clean cloud stem path for Motif vertical layering. Params used: chunk 10 s, overlap 0.1, linear fade. SCNet is NOT separately on the allowlist; MelBandRoFormer node exists but its checkpoint identity/license is unverified — route commercial stems through this node.

lanes.name: ComfyUI — Comfy Cloud platform facts measured during the audio dialog

extras.name: Active-GPU-second billing (MEASURED)
extras.note: Billing feed shows per-job gpu_seconds on rtx_pro_6000: the 170 s wall-clock music job billed 31.9 GPU-sec — queue/model-load time is effectively free; the ~0.266 credits/GPU-sec Creator rate (wave-6, verified) converts measured jobs to ~7.9 credits per 120 s track+stems and ~2.6 credits per 10 s SFX. Per-job DOLLAR cost is not exposed (invoice-level rating); gpu_seconds via the billing activity feed is the authoritative per-job figure. The whole 4-round audio dialog (all builds, tests, confirmations) cost ~44 credits = 0.6% of the monthly pool.

extras.name: Whole-graph memoization / bit-determinism (MEASURED)
extras.note: Re-running an identical graph + fixed seed billed 1.16 GPU-sec (vs ~9.8 uncached) and returned in 1.65 s wall — the cloud memoizes whole-graph results. Two implications for Motif cue families: (1) generation is bit-deterministic on pinned seeds (regenerate any cue exactly), (2) re-verification of an already-run graph is nearly free. Design every production graph with a shared seed primitive feeding all stochastic nodes.

extras.name: No AUDIO upload path into cloud graphs
extras.note: Agent-reported 2026-08-19: AUDIO-type node inputs are link-only — reference audio must be PRODUCED in-graph; there is no audio-attachment path (images have one). Binds every reference-audio workflow to local: voice cloning (Chatterbox VC, Qwen3-TTS clone), audio-style-reference music generation, and any stem-processing of externally produced tracks. Cloud audio is generate-and-process-what-you-generate.

extras.name: No audio-LoRA loader on the allowlist
extras.note: Agent-reported 2026-08-19: the generic LoraLoader (MODEL/CLIP) exists but no audio-specific LoRA loader is on the allowlist; the lora category is image/video only (KJNodes, AnimateDiff, LTX). The ACE-Step house-style OST LoRA (trainable locally, ~8 songs / ~1 hr) therefore trains AND infers on the local 5090; the cloud stays the stock-model fan-out. Complements wave-6 Gotcha: the cloud cannot TRAIN LoRAs either.

extras.name: Headless-graph trap ledger (MEASURED the hard way)
extras.note: Three traps caught during the dialog, now standing law for every graph built for the API: (1) UI-only nodes — PrimitiveNode ('Song Duration') and template CustomCombo — validate in the editor but NEVER reach /api/prompt; use PrimitiveFloat/PrimitiveInt. (2) SaveAudioMP3 is deprecated in core AND MP3 encoder padding breaks seamless loop points + stem/mix sample alignment — masters are SaveAudioAdvanced FLAC/WAV. (3) STRING node outputs (AudioLoudnessMeter.loudness_info) reach the headless output manifest only through SaveText. Corollary rule: our consumer is POST /api/prompt, so static-validation-green is a hard requirement — editor-only validity does not count.

extras.name: SA3 latent-grid duration snapping (MEASURED)
extras.note: Stable Audio 3 output length quantizes to the latent grid, not the requested seconds: 3.0 s ask -> 131,072 samples (exactly 2^17) = 2.972 s; 10 s ask -> 10.031 s. ACE-Step by contrast honored 120 s exactly (5,760,000 samples at 48 kHz). Downstream rule (logged by the Comfy Agent as expected behavior): always read actual duration from the decoded file.
